name: legacy-globals
title: Legacy global names
description: Keeps the global objects that older page scripts expect (window.Old.something), mapped onto the template's APIs, so pages move over without rewriting their scripts.

globals.description: {"Old": {"member": "path", …}} or {"Old": "path"}. A path names something on Study ("sources", "stateMachine", "store", "legacy", "plot.Plane", …) or "rawStore" (JSON localStorage with unprefixed keys, for scripts that wrote their own key names).
